summary: Weekday, Saturday and Sunday Masses and 'Confessions 15 minutes before every Mass' come from the page 1 schedule box of all three usable bulletins, with Wed/Fri 12-4 chapel Adoration, First Saturday Adoration 12:15, Sunday 3 PM Rosary & Benediction, and a fourth-Sunday Tagalog Mass. Dated: Spanish Mass Oct 11 6:15 PM and Healing Mass Nov 1 6:30 PM. Open: confessions before the two special Masses, and an unlabeled 'To Jesus Through Mary' Saturday 5:30 PM devotion. The 2019 bulletin is a wrong bulletin.
